notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Adarkar Valkyrie.
description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Thermopod
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Thermopod dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Adarkar Valkyrie.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Thermopod from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
